method: read-only log and source-package diagnosis; no CI rerun, build, container operation, product edit, or message

findings.origin: fixed-upstream dsh rc.8 runtime/test compatibility defect; not introduced by this integration
findings.cause: The rc.8 headless bundle disables the HMR row. Its launcher sees no hmr service, awaits loader.create(hmr), then immediately calls watchUserPatches without waiting for service activation. watchUserPatches synchronously reads ctx.get(hmr), sees undefined, and exits before any WeKnora tool assertion.
findings.observed: npm install and dsh plugin add succeeded; profile bundles contained dsh-base, dsh-headless and dsh-weknora. Scenario A then exited 1 with `dsh: user patch-layer watching requires the Cordis HMR service`; run-in-dsh.mjs:141 reported the secondary headless-run assertion.
repo_evidence: packages/dsh-weknora/test/e2e/run-in-dsh.mjs:128-141 writes the profile patch, boots headless, and correctly requires exit 0
Both repository files are byte-identical to fixed upstream 3e8b0bfc80b845b2d4b2ed683994748741450a97
published_package_evidence: /private/tmp/dsh-0.1.0-rc.8.tgz::package/lib/profile-boot-DG5t9aNs.js:256-264 creates hmr and immediately calls watchUserPatches without loader activation wait
/private/tmp/dsh-app-boot-0.1.0-rc.8.tgz::package/lib/index.js:761-765 immediately rejects when ctx.get(hmr) is undefined
findings.minimum_repair: Prefer a dsh release whose launcher waits for HMR activation, and bind the complete e2e install closure/cache identity. If an rc.8-only repository workaround is required, explicitly enable the existing hmr row with config root:[] in the generated test profile before boot; keep run-in-dsh.mjs:141 and all downstream tool assertions. Do not skip or make the pinned job advisory.
findings.repair_validation: NOT RUN. The suggested upstream upgrade or profile workaround was not implemented or executed in this review.
